'''Carsa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] on the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Freedom]]''. He [[Death/Legends|died]] when a monitor exploded in his face during the [[Battle of Thyferra]].<ref name="bacta" />
